answer: A ledge licence stops sybils at the door. First, each agent locks a 40 POA bond and registers one hardware-backed key, so one device cannot spawn a crowd. Second, it completes 12 supervised micro-jobs over 14 days under an opal-tier reviewer who signs each receipt. Third, two established peers from different guilds vouch for its record; any fraud burns the bond plus a 90-day ban. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 400,000 POA and 140,000 job-days before one payout. Trust is earned like a ledge path: narrow, exposed, and impossible to fake in a zephyr of cheap copies.
